XRD.normalized_intensity_std_proxy.name: XRD.normalized_intensity_std_proxy
XRD.normalized_intensity_std_proxy.semantic_definition: Standard deviation of min-shifted, peak-scaled intensity; a descriptor, not crystallinity.

XRD.dominant_peak_index_fraction.name: XRD.dominant_peak_index_fraction
XRD.dominant_peak_index_fraction.semantic_definition: Location of the dominant intensity sample as a fraction of the supplied grid.

XRD.global_halfmax_span_proxy.name: XRD.global_halfmax_span_proxy
XRD.global_halfmax_span_proxy.semantic_definition: Fractional span of samples above half the maximum intensity; not a calibrated FWHM.

XRD.spectral_entropy.name: XRD.spectral_entropy
XRD.spectral_entropy.semantic_definition: Normalized Shannon entropy of non-negative intensity mass.

XRD.peak_count_proxy.name: XRD.peak_count_proxy
XRD.peak_count_proxy.semantic_definition: Count of separated local maxima above a fixed 10% relative threshold.

REFINEMENT.target_phase_fraction.name: REFINEMENT.target_phase_fraction
REFINEMENT.target_phase_fraction.semantic_definition: Normalized refined phase weight chemically equivalent to the target compound.

REFINEMENT.precursor_phase_fraction.name: REFINEMENT.precursor_phase_fraction
REFINEMENT.precursor_phase_fraction.semantic_definition: Normalized refined phase weight chemically equivalent to an unreacted precursor.

REFINEMENT.other_identified_phase_fracti.name: REFINEMENT.other_identified_phase_fraction
REFINEMENT.other_identified_phase_fracti.semantic_definition: Normalized refined phase weight not assigned to target or precursor phases.

REFINEMENT.rwp_scaled.name: REFINEMENT.rwp_scaled
REFINEMENT.rwp_scaled.semantic_definition: Stored Rietveld Rwp divided by 10 for a bounded comparison descriptor.

SEM.inverse_gradient_scale_proxy.name: SEM.inverse_gradient_scale_proxy
SEM.inverse_gradient_scale_proxy.semantic_definition: Inverse mean absolute image gradient; no pixel-size calibration implied.

SEM.intensity_texture_std.name: SEM.intensity_texture_std
SEM.intensity_texture_std.semantic_definition: Standard deviation of normalized grayscale intensity.

SEM.median_threshold_background_fraction.name: SEM.median_threshold_background_fraction
SEM.median_threshold_background_fraction.semantic_definition: Fraction below or equal to the image median threshold.

SEM.foreground_adjacency_fraction.name: SEM.foreground_adjacency_fraction
SEM.foreground_adjacency_fraction.semantic_definition: Fraction of horizontal adjacent foreground pixels under a median threshold.

EDS.composition_error.name: EDS.composition_error
EDS.composition_error.semantic_definition: Absolute deviation of mean tabulated composition from unit sum, or mean row spread when values are not fractions.

EDS.spatial_variance.name: EDS.spatial_variance
EDS.spatial_variance.semantic_definition: Mean per-column variance across tabulated EDS rows.

EDS.element_colocalization.name: EDS.element_colocalization
EDS.element_colocalization.semantic_definition: One minus the clipped segregation descriptor.

OUTCOME.reaction_outcome_utility.name: OUTCOME.reaction_outcome_utility
OUTCOME.reaction_outcome_utility.semantic_definition: Ordinal decision utility mapped from the categorical reaction outcome; not a conversion fraction.
OUTCOME.reaction_outcome_utility.uncertainty_semantics: categorical observation mapped to decision utility
